risk_register.description: High-resolution PlanetScope imagery, valuable for small horticultural plots, may not be secured due to cost/access constraints, weakening coverage where the sub-pixel problem bites hardest.
risk_register.mitigation: Treat PlanetScope as an optional enhancement; build the core on open Copernicus Sentinel-1 + Sentinel-2 data; resolve access early (RQ8). [Affects: WP1 (Probabilistic multi-sensor diagnosis of the field state)]

risk_register.description: Reconciling the differing spatial and temporal resolutions of radar, optical, soil and weather sources may fail or degrade the fusion quality.
risk_register.mitigation: Geospatial/time-series data platform with QC; temporal compositing; explicit resolution handling. [Affects: WP1 (Probabilistic multi-sensor diagnosis of the field state)]

risk_register.description: Cloud cover limits Sentinel-2 optical availability, while dense vegetation reduces Sentinel-1 SAR retrieval accuracy - the two sensors' complementary weaknesses.
risk_register.mitigation: Lean on Sentinel-1 SAR through cloud; cloud masking; vegetation-aware retrieval. [Affects: WP1 (Probabilistic multi-sensor diagnosis of the field state)]

risk_register.description: Few large-scale efforts collect dense ground truth, so the validation may be under-powered to establish credibility.
risk_register.mitigation: Plan field trials with dense ground truth (RQ4); use a cost-effective sensor network. [Affects: WP3 (Field validation, ground truth and uncertainty calibration)]

risk_register.description: Route B's central assumption - that the chosen homogeneous patch genuinely covaries with the target crop - may not hold, invalidating the proxy.
risk_register.mitigation: Pre-register a covariation test; measure covariation (control stand) rather than assume it (RQ9). [Affects: WP3 (Field validation, ground truth and uncertainty calibration)]

risk_register.description: The framework's headline commitment - honest uncertainty - fails if e.g. 90% prediction intervals do not contain the truth about 90% of the time.
risk_register.mitigation: Build uncertainty-calibration metrics into the validation protocol (RQ5); use uncertainty-aware calibration end to end. [Affects: WP2 (Uncertainty-aware decision engine and demonstrator integration), WP3 (Field validation, ground truth and uncertainty calibration)]

risk_register.description: The rigorous one-step probabilistic fusion route may exceed available modelling expertise, validation data or compute within the fellowship.
risk_register.mitigation: Keep Route B as a credible fallback; stage the build; provision the probabilistic-modelling compute runtime. [Affects: WP1 (Probabilistic multi-sensor diagnosis of the field state)]

risk_register.description: Calibrating AquaCrop to a single overconfident parameter set would break the uncertainty chain and produce falsely confident decisions.
risk_register.mitigation: Uncertainty-aware AquaCrop calibration that retains parameter uncertainty (the fellow-attributed method, doi:10.1016/j.envsoft.2022.105556). [Affects: WP2 (Uncertainty-aware decision engine and demonstrator integration)]

risk_register.description: Integrating and calibrating heterogeneous sensors (radar, optical, soil, weather) adds complexity that can degrade signal quality.
risk_register.mitigation: QC pipeline; sensor comparison in the validation layer. [Affects: WP1 (Probabilistic multi-sensor diagnosis of the field state), WP3 (Field validation, ground truth and uncertainty calibration)]

risk_register.description: Operational frameworks unifying all sensors at scale are scarce, so the demonstrator may not reach a usable pilot within the fellowship.
risk_register.mitigation: Frame the MVP as a standalone research demonstrator; partners assist (feedback, farmer access, testing) rather than own or operate it; set the TRL target explicitly (RQ10). [Affects: WP2 (Uncertainty-aware decision engine and demonstrator integration), WP5 (Dissemination, exploitation, communication and management)]

issues.category: Artificial Intelligence (Section A.4 Category 8 / MSCA-PF Part B Section 1.2)
issues.description: WP1 implements a probabilistic field-state estimator using SAR and optical sensor fusion with a parameter posterior (T1-02, T1-03). WP2 builds an uncertainty-aware AquaCrop calibration module and a counterfactual irrigation decision engine (T2-01, T2-02), integrated into a research demonstrator web MVP (T2-03). These constitute AI-based systems under the Section A.4 Category 8 framework and require consideration of whether ethical concerns related to human rights and values arise in the agricultural decision-support context.
issues.applicable_tier1_rule: ethics_self_assessment_required: Applicants must complete an ethics self-assessment; projects with ethics issues may undergo ethics review and ethics requirements may become contractual obligations. Source: implementation_constraints.json; wp-15-general-annexes_horizon-2026-2027_en.pdf p.16; programme-guide_horizon_en.pdf pp.25-28.
issues.source_basis: Tier 1: implementation_constraints.json (ethics_self_assessment_required, wp-15-general-annexes_horizon-2026-2027_en.pdf p.16; programme-guide_horizon_en.pdf pp.25-28). Project activity evidence: wp_structure.json WP1 objectives (probabilistic field-state estimator), T1-02 (probabilistic fusion model), T1-03 (calibrate and evaluate diagnostic branch); WP2 objectives (uncertainty-aware AquaCrop calibration, counterfactual irrigation simulation, decision engine), T2-01, T2-02, T2-03. The Tier 3 compliance_profile.json records ethics_review_required: true as a compliance flag derived during call binding; no Tier 2B extracted source in scope_requirements.json or call_constraints.json for HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01 cites AI ethics review as a topic-specific mandate beyond the Tier 1 universal programme rule.
issues.mitigation_note: Phase 8 drafting must address Section A.4 Category 8 (AI) in the application form, specifying the nature of the AI systems, their application domain (agricultural irrigation support — civil-only), and how ethical concerns related to human rights and values are addressed or absent in the agricultural context.

issues.description: WP3 collects ground-truth data and runs a validation protocol against diagnostic branch outputs (T3-01: Design validation protocol and ground truth collection). If field-level data collection involves farm-specific or farmer-identifiable information from agricultural operators, Category 4 personal data provisions apply. This flag is conditional on the data collection methodology confirmed in Phase 8.
issues.applicable_tier1_rule: ethics_appraisal_summary: Ethics appraisal covers proportionality of methods and applicant awareness of ethical and social impacts. Source: implementation_constraints.json; programme-guide_horizon_en.pdf pp.25-28.
issues.source_basis: Tier 1: implementation_constraints.json (ethics_appraisal_summary, programme-guide_horizon_en.pdf pp.25-28). Project activity: wp_structure.json WP3 objectives (collect ground truth data, run validation protocol), T3-01 (ground truth collection, contributing partners HOST and SUPERVISOR). Flag is conditional: if data collection is limited to publicly available satellite data (Sentinel-1 SAR, Sentinel-2) and anonymous field sensors, Category 4 may not be triggered. Phase 8 must confirm.
issues.mitigation_note: Phase 8 drafting of Section A.4 must confirm whether personally identifiable agricultural operator data is collected. If so, GDPR compliance measures, data minimisation, and consent procedures must be specified.

issues.description: All project activities across WP1-WP5 must have an exclusive focus on civil applications. The agricultural decision-support domain (soil moisture estimation, irrigation management) is inherently civil. No dual-use concern has been identified at Phase 6 level, but the civil-focus declaration (Declaration 7) must be completed explicitly in the application form.
issues.applicable_tier1_rule: civil_focus_constraint: Projects must focus exclusively on civil applications; certain human-embryo/cloning/heritable-genome-modification activities are excluded from funding. Source: implementation_constraints.json; wp-15-general-annexes_horizon-2026-2027_en.pdf pp.14-17; ef_he-ria-ia_en.pdf p.7.
issues.source_basis: Tier 1: implementation_constraints.json (civil_focus_constraint, wp-15-general-annexes_horizon-2026-2027_en.pdf pp.14-17). Project scope: wp_structure.json WP1-WP5 all address agricultural EO sensor fusion, irrigation decision support, career development, and dissemination. No dual-use application identified at this stage.
issues.mitigation_note: Declaration 7 in Section A.4 of the application form must be completed affirming exclusive civil focus. Phase 8 drafting must confirm no activity crosses into dual-use or excluded categories.

issues.category: Open Science and FAIR Data Ethics (Section A.4 Category 9 / MSCA-PF Section 1.2)
issues.description: The action mandates FAIR data management (DMP deliverable D5-01 due month 6, WP5 T5-01) and open-access publication of research outputs (T5-02). Responsible handling of EO and sensor data including potential data sharing obligations must be addressed in the DMP. These requirements are confirmed by Tier 2B scope requirements SR-06 and SR-07 and call constraints CC-10 and CC-11.
issues.applicable_tier1_rule: dissemination_and_exploitation_requirement: Applications must include a plan for exploitation and dissemination of results including communication activities unless topic conditions provide otherwise; beneficiaries must later update a complete plan. Source: implementation_constraints.json; wp-15-general-annexes_horizon-2026-2027_en.pdf p.4; programme-guide_horizon_en.pdf pp.33-39.
issues.source_basis: Tier 1: implementation_constraints.json (dissemination_and_exploitation_requirement). Tier 2B: scope_requirements.json SR-06 (training activities must integrate digital skills, FAIR data management; source_section: Scope – Training activities; Confirmed) and SR-07 (Career Development Plan covering publications and participation in open science events; source_section: Scope – Career Development Plan; Confirmed). Tier 2B: call_constraints.json CC-10 (training must foster Open Science culture, knowledge valorisation, research integrity; Confirmed) and CC-11 (fellows must be prepared for digital collaboration, FAIR data management, societal engagement; Confirmed). Compliance_profile.json open_science_requirements fields directly cite SR-06, SR-07, CC-10, CC-11 — these are confirmed in Tier 2B extracted files and cited here with Tier 2B traceability.
issues.mitigation_note: DMP (D5-01, due month 6) must address FAIR principles for EO datasets (Sentinel-1 SAR, Sentinel-2) and any ground sensor data. Phase 8 must address open science practices in MSCA-PF Part B-1 Section 1.2. Career Development Plan (D4-01, due month 3) must cover publications and open science event participation per CC-12.

ethics_assessment.self_assessment_statement: The project activities across WP1-WP5 require completion of the ethics self-assessment as mandated by Tier 1 programme rules (implementation_constraints.json: ethics_self_assessment_required; wp-15-general-annexes_horizon-2026-2027_en.pdf p.16; programme-guide_horizon_en.pdf pp.25-28). Four ethics flags have been identified at Phase 6 level: (ETH-01) AI-based probabilistic modelling and decision engine in WP1-WP2 require consideration under Section A.4 Category 8; (ETH-02) WP3 ground-truth data collection may involve personal data if farm-operator-identifiable information is collected — Phase 8 must confirm data collection methodology and apply Category 4 if applicable; (ETH-03) civil-focus Declaration 7 must be completed for all WP1-WP5 activities; (ETH-04) open science and FAIR data obligations are confirmed by Tier 2B scope requirements SR-06 and SR-07 and call constraints CC-10 and CC-11, requiring a DMP deliverable D5-01 by month 6. The Tier 3 compliance_profile.json records ethics_review_required: true as a compliance flag derived during call binding; no Tier 2B extracted source in scope_requirements.json or call_constraints.json for HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01 cites ethics review as a topic-specific mandate beyond the Tier 1 universal programme rule that projects with identified ethics issues may undergo ethics review (implementation_constraints.json). Integration of the gender dimension in research and innovation content follows the Tier 1 default rule that it is mandatory unless the topic explicitly states non-relevance (implementation_constraints.json: gender_dimension_in_content; programme-guide_horizon_en.pdf pp.17-20; wp-15-general-annexes_horizon-2026-2027_en.pdf p.24; ef_he-ria-ia_en.pdf pp.4-5). No Tier 2B exemption source is currently cited in this Phase 6 artifact; Phase 8 drafting must either add the relevant Tier 2B topic-source reference or keep the claim framed as pending call-specific confirmation. Gender management balance: beneficiaries must promote equal opportunities between men and women and aim for gender balance at all levels of personnel assigned to the action per Tier 1 (wp-15-general-annexes_horizon-2026-2027_en.pdf p.18; implementation_constraints.json: gender_management_balance_guidance). HOST (ELTE) as a higher education establishment in an EU Member State must have a Gender Equality Plan at grant signature and during the grant; the Tier 3 compliance_profile.json records gender_plan_required: true as a compliance flag derived during call binding; no Tier 2B extracted source for HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01 cites GEP as a topic-specific mandate beyond the Tier 1 programme rule (implementation_constraints.json: gender_equality_plan_eligibility; wp-15-general-annexes_horizon-2026-2027_en.pdf pp.18-19; programme-guide_horizon_en.pdf pp.16-17). Ethics appraisal will cover compliance with ethical principles, relevant legislation, proportionality of methods, and applicant awareness of ethical and social impacts per Tier 1 (implementation_constraints.json: ethics_appraisal_summary; programme-guide_horizon_en.pdf pp.25-28).
